newsitem.title: GERMANY: RWE to pay 2.2 bln dmk into phone jv in May.
newsitem.headline: RWE to pay 2.2 bln dmk into phone jv in May.

text.p: German diversified utility RWE AG said on Friday that it plans to pay 2.2 billion marks into o.tel.o., its telecommunications joint venture with Veba AG, in May.
RWE said the payment was in line with its contractual obligation and would be taken from its cash flow and existing group funds.

When RWE entered the joint venture in autumn it had said it would pay a total of about 3.6 billion marks into the venture. RWE had previously quit a telecommunications alliance with Viag AG and British Telecom.
Cable & Wireless has left the alliance with Veba and o.tel.o is now a joint venture between RWE and Veba.
